basic_details.job_title: RWFSA Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Sportspersons Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Rail Wheel Factory Sports Association (RWFSA) has officially announced the Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 with 5 openings. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. Candidates aged between 18 and 25 years as on the date of trials who fulfill the eligibility norms prescribed in the latest Railway Board Circulars are eligible to apply. The application process is being conducted in offline mode, and the last date to submit the application is 24-08-2026. Direct links to download the official notification and application details are

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Rail Wheel Factory Sports Association (RWFSA) for various sportspersons posts. It is a government job opportunity under the Indian Railways.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Sportspersons. Various sports disciplines like Cricket, Hockey, Football, and Kabaddi are included in this notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in RWFSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for Sportspersons posts in the Rail Wheel Factory Sports Association Recruitment 2026 across different sports categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for RWFSA Sportspersons posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the RWFSA Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for RWFSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the completed application form for the RWFSA Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 is 24 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Sportspersons posts must be between 18 to 25 years of age as on the date of trails. Age relaxation details should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must fulfill norms as per the latest Railway Board Circulars for sportspersons recruitment. A graduate degree is generally the minimum qualification required for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RWFSA Sportspersons Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for RWFSA Sportspersons includes Talent Scouting, Field Trails, and a final Selection round. Performance in these stages will determine eligibility.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for Rail Wheel Factory Sports Association?
faq.answer: The official website for Rail Wheel Factory Sports Association and this recruitment is www.rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. All official updates and application forms will be available there.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these Sportspersons posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Sportspersons recruited by Rail Wheel Factory Sports Association will be in Bangalore, Karnataka, specifically at the Rail Wheel Factory in Yelahanka.
